title: 第17章 一荣俱荣，一损俱损
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “那个兵，晃什么晃？”“刚坐下屁股上就长刺，是不是？啊！”“来，调整调整.......所有人听口令，撤凳，给我蹲姿看新闻联播！”阅览室里，正准备集体观看新闻联播的新兵们全都被整麻了。蹲姿训练，是部队里一项非常基础的训练科目，但最多五分钟腿就得麻。再往后，那身上就跟生了跳蚤，两条腿就像是被针扎似的，又麻又酸又疼。所有人都清楚这会儿的连长正在气头上，于是赶紧将马札撤走，屁股落在垫起的脚后跟上。高峰一眼扫过去，冷哼一声：“毛病！都特么惯得，一个个的！”换做以往，指导员这会儿高低得站出来说两句，但这会儿却一反常态的没动静。陆阳知道，这正是白天“泄密”事件带来的负面影响，甚至于往后几天，他们都别想有好日子过。......“今天的新闻联播节目播送完了，感谢您的收看......”七点三十分，新闻联播结束的片尾曲准时响起。在场新兵一个个面露痛苦，身体东倒西歪的蹲着。即便是那些个老兵班长，额头也挂满汗珠，稍显吃力模样。任何一项训练，老兵和新兵所感受到的折磨和痛苦其实都是一样的。只不过，老兵通过不断磨练身体，锤炼意志，提升了自已的承受上限，渐渐也就习惯了。此时的陆阳同样也在苦苦支撑着，被压在屁股下头的右脚早就底麻了，甚至都感受不到它的存在。但系统面板不断向上的箭头符号，给了他坚持下去的动力，让他硬生生咬牙坚挺着。正是这份坚持，让陆阳始终挺拔腰杆，在这群蹲的东倒西歪的新兵里显得格外突出。甚至于乍一看，会有种三班出现了两个老兵的错觉？比起那些百炼成钢的老兵班长们而言，陆阳还是有所欠缺。但所展现出的意志力，依旧让高峰颇为满意。好兵，就得百炼成钢，这点磨练都扛不住，能成什么大事儿？指导员也是同样想法，即便是文职干事，也得有充沛的体力和坚韧的意志力。不然，碰到像白天这样的问题，一下子就被击垮了，还怎么理清头绪处理解决？直到天气预报开始播送，连长这才用遥控器关掉电视，准许重新坐回凳子上。所有人的屁股仿佛得到救赎，摇晃的身体也终于如释重负。被压麻的双腿也在这一刻，从脚底板释放出令人头皮发麻的刺痛感。这种极致的酸爽，只有经历过的，只有当过兵的人，才懂得是什么滋味。高峰黑着脸，怒声道：“就今天白天，发生了一件极其恶劣的事。三班有个新兵，竟然偷拍营区建筑，成绩册等照片，通过聊天软件发到网上！”“这样的举动简直令人发指，这是什么行为？这叫涉密，情节严重是要被送上军事法庭，牢底坐穿的！”新兵们内心惶恐，集体咕咚了一下喉咙。在部队这种封闭的环境下，几乎藏不住什么秘密。更何况上午那件事闹得那么大，他们自然也都听说了。而且各班排长回班以后，立马就紧急没收了所有人的手机，检查是否存在类似的泄密行为。并召开班务会，严肃强调军人保密守着的重要性，严防死守杜绝此类现象发生。高峰毫不客气，直接点名批评了整个三班，搞得包括陆阳在内的每个人心里都不舒服。尤其是，当班长周凯东被指名道姓的要求站到前面，当着全连的面做深刻检讨时，大家更是有种特别窝囊憋屈的无力感。这一刻他们才意识到什么叫一荣俱荣，一损俱损。一人犯错，后果是全班一起在承担。往后想在其他班面前抬起头，怕是也难了。上午的事发生后，所有电子产品全部没收，周末放松宣告结束，强行改为训练。午餐时间缩短，午休取消，晚上看个新闻联播，还被连长给找茬似的叼了一顿。而这一切，都是三班某个人犯错后，造成的一系列连锁反应。即便其他班嘴上不说，但莫名遭受无妄之灾，心里头肯定非常不爽。“以上，就是我对于此次‘泄密’事件的全部检讨内容.......”“下去吧！”周凯东检讨完毕，拿着检讨灰溜溜的回到座位。看着最终还是班长默默把一切给承受下来，众人心里更不舒服了。明明不是班长的错，结果那家伙在舒舒服服的关禁闭，错误却要让周凯东来承担，真是他娘的害人害已！连长批评完，指导员也站了出来说了几句，在原则性问题上，他不再像以往那般好说话。“特三团是打鬼子时期就存在的英雄部队，是雪山上一座座屹立不倒的丰碑，团史馆里的光荣事迹更是数都数不清！”“迄今为止，咱们团还从来没发生过这样的事，所以我们必须要引以为戒，严防死守任何泄密行为，坚决不犯原则性错误！”“尤其是一些在外头有对象的，性格张扬，喜好炫耀嘚瑟的，必须给我把你那颗心按住了！”“即便是你们的父母亲人，问起部队细节，让你拍两张照片回去，也坚决不能妥协！”“如果，再有此类现象发生，严惩不贷！该处分处分，该走人走人！”“好了，差不多了.......”连长看看手表，总结性的来了这么一句。就在新兵们暗自庆幸终于结束时，大家最不希望的一幕还是发生了。“老惯例，新闻联播结束，找几个人点评总结一下。”“第五排，左边第三个，对，就你，别看了！”被点到名的新兵从凳子上颤巍巍的站起身，大脑一片空白。先前新闻联播，他腿被压麻了，所以压根就没仔细看。再加上结束后还批评了三班，打了个岔，现在哪还记得新闻讲了些啥？尤其当他走到前面，被全连上百双眼睛盯着，更是害怕的直哆嗦。“开始吧。”“额，额，那个，额，这个......”“你属鹅的，在这下蛋呢？抓紧时间！”连长不耐烦的催促，让本就紧张的新兵更加紧张。结结巴巴的憋了半天，说的前言不搭后语，根本就没人能听懂。最终，他也因此喜提五十个俯卧撑的小惩罚。部队里，大家是愿意看新闻联播的，毕竟这是他们唯一看电视的机会。但没人愿意被抓到点评，尤其是那些老实巴交，还带着点儿社恐，不善言辞的兵，点评简直就是噩梦一般的存在。但事实上，这么做的目的就是为了锻炼大家的口才，培养落落大方的气质。越是紧张，越是会给人一种没自信，畏畏缩缩的感觉。军人，就应该挺胸抬头，自信满满，气势如虹！连长继续点人，他的目光像是雷达一样扫过全场，所到之处无一人敢与其对视。很快，他就和一个直愣愣的目光连接上了。“就你了！”“啊？”“啊个屁，上来！”原本，这个兵是想要反其道而行之，结果聪明反被聪明误。虽说，这个兵没先前那般紧张，但站在台上被这么多人注视，依旧会感到紧张和放不开。“那个...我简单说几句；国外很乱，国内很好，科技进步，文化发展。报告，我点评完了......”“给我上一边去！”高峰冲着他屁股就是一脚，随后指着这个兵的班长：“还特么会给我套公式了，你教的？”那个班长疯狂摇头：“报告，绝对不是我！”高峰也懒得跟他废话：“你俩，一人一百个俯卧撑，滚墙角做去！”指导员摇了摇头：连长正愁没地儿撒气呢，居然还敢有人投机取巧，往枪口上撞？看着这回罚的更重，甚至连老兵班长都跟着后头遭了殃，现场人人自危，生怕会成为下一个倒霉蛋。忽然，连长目光落在三班区域，这下子连周凯东都有些慌了。一天内被连着搞了好几次，就算他是个老兵心态也得崩。咕咚！别选我，别选我，别选我！孔垄把头埋低，但余光却依旧和连长产生连接，吓得他心都快跳出嗓子眼了。打上学那会儿起，他就最怕被老师点名回答问题，尤其是上讲台做题目的那种。因为经常做不出来，被挂黑板上，导致他也被老师骂：头脑简单，四肢发达。没想到，都特么跑来当兵了，竟还是没能逃脱这噩梦！就在连长伸出手指，冷笑着指向孔垄时，一道洪亮的报告突然响起。陆阳竟先一步主动站起身：“报告，我想点评！”这一秒，所有人的目光全部集中到他身上。人人避之不及，你竟还敢主动争取？不知道连长吃了火药，正在气头上？孔垄扭头看向陆阳，激动的眼泪都快下来了：“好兄弟，好兄弟啊！”
content_en: "That soldier, what are you shaking about?" "You have a thorn on your butt as soon as you sit down, right? Ah!" "Come on, adjust... Everyone listen to the command, remove the stools, and squat for me to watch the news broadcast!" In the reading room, all the recruits who were preparing to watch the news broadcast collectively were numbed.Squatting training is a very basic training subject in the army, but your legs will become numb in five minutes at most.Later, it looked like there were fleas on my body, and my legs felt like they were pricked by needles, numb, sore and painful.Everyone knew that the company commander was furious at this moment, so he quickly moved Mazha away, his buttocks falling on the raised heels.Gao Feng glanced over and snorted: "What's wrong! They're all so used to it, one by one!" In the past, the instructor would have stood up and said a few words, but now he was uncharacteristically silent.Lu Yang knew that this was the negative impact of the "leak" incident during the day, and that they would not even think about having a good life in the next few days...."Today's Xinwen Lianbo program has been broadcast. Thank you for watching..." At 7:30, the ending song of the Xinwen Lianbang ended on time.All the new recruits present showed pain on their faces and squatted staggeringly.Even the veteran squad leaders had beads of sweat hanging on their foreheads, looking like they were struggling.In any training, the torture and pain felt by veterans and recruits are actually the same.It's just that through continuous training of the body and will, the veteran has raised the upper limit of his endurance, and gradually got used to it.At this time, Lu Yang was also struggling to hold on. His right foot, which was pressed under his butt, was already numb and he couldn't even feel its presence.But the upward arrow symbol on the system panel gave him the motivation to persevere, making him grit his teeth and hold on.It was this persistence that made Lu Yang stand out among the squatting and stumbling recruits.Even at first glance, there would be an illusion that there are two veterans in the third class?Compared with those veteran squad leaders who have been tempered into steel, Lu Yang still lacks something.But the willpower displayed still made Gao Feng quite satisfied.A good soldier must be refined into steel. If he can't withstand this little training, what big thing can he achieve?The instructor has the same idea. Even a civilian officer must have sufficient physical strength and tenacity of willpower.Otherwise, if you encounter a problem like this during the day, you will be overwhelmed all of a sudden. How can you sort out the clues and deal with it?It wasn't until the weather forecast started broadcasting that the company commander used the remote control to turn off the TV and allowed him to sit back on the stool.Everyone's butts seemed to have been saved, and their shaking bodies were finally relieved.At this moment, the numbed legs released a numbing tingling sensation from the soles of their feet.Only those who have experienced this ultimate sourness, and only those who have been soldiers, know what it feels like.Gao Feng said with a dark face, "An extremely bad thing happened during the day today. There was a recruit in the third class who secretly took photos of the camp building, grade books, etc., and posted them online through chat software!" "Such an action is simply outrageous. What kind of behavior is this? This is called confidentiality. If the circumstances are serious, they will be sent to a military court and jailed!" The recruits were frightened and collectively clapped their throats.In the closed environment of the army, it is almost impossible to hide any secrets.What's more, the incident in the morning caused such a big fuss, so naturally they all heard about it.Moreover, after each squad leader returned to work, he immediately confiscated everyone's mobile phones to check whether there were similar leaks.A squad meeting was also held to seriously emphasize the importance of military personnel keeping confidentiality and to strictly guard against such phenomena.Gao Feng was not polite and directly criticized the entire third class by name, making everyone including Lu Yang feel uncomfortable.Especially when squad leader Zhou Kaidong was asked by name to stand in the front and make a profound self-examination in front of the entire company, everyone felt even more helpless and aggrieved.Only at this moment did they realize what it means to be both prosperous and disadvantaged.If one person makes a mistake, the whole class will bear the consequences.I'm afraid it will be difficult to raise my head in front of other classes in the future.After what happened in the morning, all electronic products were confiscated. The weekend relaxation was declared over and was forcibly changed to training.The lunch time was shortened, the lunch break was cancelled, and I watched the news broadcast in the evening, and was even eaten by the company commander as if he was looking for trouble.And all of this is a series of chain reactions caused by someone in class three making a mistake.Even if other classes don't say it, they must be very upset if they suffer unexplained disasters."The above is my entire review of this 'leak' incident..." "Go down!" Zhou Kaidong finished his review and returned to his seat with the review in hand.Seeing that it was the monitor who silently endured everything in the end, everyone felt even more uncomfortable.It was obviously not the squad leader's fault, but the guy ended up in solitary confinement comfortably, yet Zhou Kaidong had to bear the responsibility for his mistake. It was really fucking harmful to others!After the company commander finished criticizing, the instructor also stood up and said a few words. On issues of principle, he was no longer as easy to talk as before."The Special Third Regiment is a heroic unit that existed during the anti-Japanese period. They are monuments that stand tall on the snowy mountains. The glorious deeds in the regiment history museum are countless!" "So far, such a thing has never happened to our regiment, so we must take warning and strictly guard against any leaks of secrets and resolutely not make principled mistakes!" "Especially those who have targets outside and have flamboyant personalities."If you like to show off, you must hold your heart down!""Even if your parents and relatives ask you to take two photos back, you will not compromise!""If this happens again, you will be severely punished! It's time to leave!""Okay, that's it..." the company commander said in conclusion, looking at his watch.Just when the recruits were secretly glad that it was finally over, the scene that everyone least expected happened."Old practice, after the news broadcast is over, find a few people to comment and summarize." "Fifth row, third from the left, yes, it's you, don't watch!" The recruit whose name was called stood up from the stool tremblingly, his mind going blank.During the previous news broadcast, his legs were numb from the pressure, so he didn't watch it carefully at all.In addition, after the end, I criticized Class 3 and got distracted. How can I still remember what the news said?Especially when he walked to the front and was stared at by hundreds of pairs of eyes from the entire company, he shivered with fear."Let's start." "Uh, uh, that, uh, this..." "You are a goose, why are you laying eggs here? Hurry up!" the company commander urged impatiently, making the already nervous recruits even more nervous.I stammered for a long time, and my words didn't match the words at all, so no one could understand them.In the end, he was punished with fifty push-ups.In the army, everyone is willing to watch the news broadcast. After all, this is their only chance to watch TV.But no one wants to be caught commenting, especially those soldiers who are honest, arrogant, and a little bit social-phobic. Commenting is a nightmare.But in fact, the purpose of this is to exercise everyone's eloquence and cultivate a generous temperament.The more nervous you are, the more you will feel less confident and timid.Soldiers should hold their chests high and their heads high, confident and full of momentum!The company commander continued to order people. His eyes swept the entire place like radar, and no one dared to look at him wherever he went.Soon, he was connected with a blank stare."It's you!" "Huh?" "Oh shit, come up here!" Originally, this soldier wanted to do the opposite, but his cleverness was mistaken for him.Although this soldier is not as nervous as before, he still feels nervous and unable to let go when standing on the stage and being watched by so many people."Well... let me just say a few words; it's a mess abroad, but it's very good at home, with scientific and technological progress and cultural development. I've finished commenting on the report..." "Get over here!" Gao Feng kicked him in the butt, and then pointed at the squad leader of the soldier: "You're going to give me a formula.", you taught me?" The squad leader shook his head wildly: "Report, it's definitely not me!" Gao Feng didn't bother to talk nonsense to him: "You two, do a hundred push-ups each, go to the corner!" The instructor shook his head: The company commander was worried that he had no place to vent his anger, but someone dared to take advantage of it and hit the gun?Seeing that the punishment was heavier this time, even the veteran squad leader suffered the consequences. Everyone at the scene was in danger, fearing that they would become the next unlucky person.Suddenly, the company commander's eyes fell on the third squad area, and now even Zhou Kaidong was a little panicked.After being fucked several times in one day, even a veteran would lose his mentality.Gudong!Don't choose me, don't choose me, don't choose me!Kong Long lowered his head, but out of the corner of his eye he still connected with the company commander, which frightened him so much that his heart nearly jumped out of his throat.Ever since he was in school, he has been most afraid of being called on by the teacher to answer questions, especially when he goes to the podium to answer questions.Because he often couldn't do it well, he was put on the blackboard, which led to him being scolded by the teacher: he was simple-minded and had strong limbs.Unexpectedly, even though he came to serve as a soldier, he still couldn't escape this nightmare!Just when the company commander stretched out his finger and pointed at Kong Long with a sneer, a loud report suddenly sounded.Lu Yang actually stood up first and said, "Report, I want to comment!" At this second, everyone's eyes were focused on him.Everyone avoids you, but you dare to take the initiative to fight for it?I wonder if the company commander has eaten gunpowder and is angry?Kong Long turned to look at Lu Yang, tears of excitement almost came down his face: "Good brother, good brother!"
